I used to frequent this clinic because it's close to home and the service has always been good. However, recently, they've had a huge number of patients and not enough doctors, yet they're accepting so many bookings that the doctors are rushing through the procedures. But after waiting for 40 minutes, the receptionist informed me that I might have to wait another 20 minutes, and if I wasn't finished, they would call a doctor or quickly switch me to a different doctor if one finished earlier. However, I had already checked and confirmed that the doctor was available at that time. It shouldn't have been an hour late. First of all, I'd like to inform you that I'm a hotel employee whose job requires a good appearance, personality, and smile. However, my oral and dental health was very poor; I had many cavities and several teeth that couldn't be saved. Therefore, I decided to make a major life change by taking care of my oral and dental health. I was recommended by a client who had previously used their services, saying they did a good job at a reasonable price.
I decided to consult with Dr. M, who was very welcoming and friendly. She provided the correct treatment and excellent service, which is why I chose to travel from far away (I live in Phran Nok). I wasn't disappointed at all. From someone who was discouraged by seeing children being taken to dental clinics by their parents, I realized I hadn't been taking care of myself.
Now, I can smile without embarrassment. From someone who rarely smiled, I've become someone who can smile broadly, speaks more confidently, and has gained more confidence.
Thank you to Dr. M and all the staff at this clinic. Sometimes, the way I walked in to have my mouth examined at a clinic was different from how I was treated here.
